newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Rio state reschedules gas co sell-off to July 14.
newsitem.headline: Rio state reschedules gas co sell-off to July 14.

text.p: The Brazilian state of Rio de Janeiro said it has rescheduled the privatization auction of its gas company Companhia Estadual de Gas (CEG) and piped gas distributor Riogas to July 14.
The auction had been previously set for July 10, a spokeswoman for the state's Finance Secretariat said.
She said full tender documents for the auction will be published Friday, including the minimum price and the amount of privatization bonds that investors will be allowed to use to pay for the shares.
The Rio state government will sell 58.87 percent of CEG's voting capital together with a 83.6 percent voting stake in Riogas, a company created early this year to distribute piped gas in the state.
The shares will be sold at a closed-envelope auction on the Rio de Janeiro Stock Exchange.
